pages.text: IF runs its code block only when its expression is true. An ELSE block runs otherwise. With an ELSE, the first END stands alone. The last END is followed by IF.
$(1)IF prime ;$(br)BEGIN$(br)  ASSIGN primes primes ⊕ candidate ⊕ " " ;$(br)END$(br)ELSE$(br)BEGIN$(br)  NOOP$(br)END IF$()
There is no ELSE IF. Put another IF inside the ELSE block instead.
